protocol: RS485/I2C with base64 framing per NL EPS Communication Protocol V1.0
description: NL Spacehawk 16U Power Bus EPS subsystem MIB. 16 PDU output channels (CH1-CH14 wired, CH15-CH16 reserved), 1 PDU + 3 BMS + 1 MPPT card.

nodes.name: PDU1
nodes.description: Power Distribution Unit MCU (Output Channel card)

nodes.name: BMS1
nodes.description: Battery Management board #1 — first battery card

nodes.name: BMS2
nodes.description: Battery Management board #2 — second battery card

nodes.name: BMS3
nodes.description: Battery Management board #3 — third battery card

channels_note: NL16U 16U Power Bus has 16 output channels: 14 wired to subsystems and 2 reserved (CH15, CH16). Channel state is encoded as a 16-bit mask in 2 bytes (CH1-CH8 in byte 0 LSB-first, CH9-CH16 in byte 1 LSB-first).
